text: And we are underway! Arsenal get the match started. The roar from the Parisian ultras is deafening.
Enzo clips a ball towards Reece James, but Nuno Mendes is up quickly to head it back into the Arsenal half.
Arsenal's tactical shape is apparent. As Colwill carries the ball forward, Cucurella drifts inside to create a numerical advantage in the middle.
First sign of danger! Vitinha slides a pass into the channel for Mbappé... but the flag is up. Just offside. A warning shot fired.
Cole Palmer gets his first touches, drifting inside. He tries to nutmeg Ugarte, but the Uruguayan stands his ground.
Dembélé whips in a dangerous cross towards the near post. Colwill does brilliantly to get in front of his man and head it clear.
Arsenal are living dangerously. Vitinha nicks the ball off Caicedo! It breaks for Zaïre-Emery on the edge of the box! He shoots! Blocked by Fofana!
Dembélé's corner finds Marquinhos, who rises highest! His powerful header is straight at Petrovic, who holds on securely.
A moment of respite for Arsenal. Jackson draws a foul from Beraldo. Enzo takes it quickly with a 50-yard diagonal to Reece James.
James drives forward and beats Mendes, but Vitinha has tracked back an incredible distance to slide in and block the cross for a corner.
Arsenal work a short corner. Mudryk receives the ball inside the box but his first-time shot is wild, high and wide. A wasted opportunity.
Manchester City are patient now, moving the ball across the backline, trying to draw Arsenal's press out.
Magic from Dembélé! He jinks past Cucurella and cuts it back low across the six-yard box. Colwill just gets a vital touch to divert it away from Kolo Muani.
Arsenal break! Nkunku feeds Jackson, who cuts inside and curls a shot towards the far corner... it's just wide of the post! Donnarumma was scrambling.
Hakimi flies down the right and delivers a cross. It falls to Mbappé at the back post, but he slices his volley. A rare miscue.
Petrovic rolls it to Enzo, who clips a perfectly-weighted pass over the top for Mudryk's run, but Hakimi matches him for pace.
Mbappé drops deep. He lays it off to Vitinha and spins in behind, but Fofana reads it superbly and intercepts.
GOAL FOR MANCHESTER CITY! A lightning counter-attack! Vitinha slides an inch-perfect through ball to Mbappé, who is one-on-one and curls it with devastating precision into the far bottom corner.
Arsenal look shell-shocked. That is the danger you face here. One slip in concentration, and you are punished.
Yellow card. Moisés Caicedo goes into the book for cynically pulling back Dembélé to prevent a counter-attack.
Manchester City are buzzing. Zaïre-Emery glides past two challenges and switches play to Mendes, but Reece James is alert to the danger.
Arsenal manage to string a sequence of passes together, trying to draw the sting out of the game and regain their composure.
Good play from Arsenal! Jackson's shot is blocked by Marquinhos. The rebound falls to Mudryk, but his effort is comfortable for Donnarumma.
Hakimi gets to the byline again and crosses. Kolo Muani leaps and heads it down... but Petrovic is there to smother it!
A lull in the action as Nuno Mendes receives some treatment. A chance for both teams to take on instructions.
Mendes is back on his feet and we are back underway. Arsenal have possession, trying to build from the back again.
Enzo shows his class. Under pressure, he spins away from Vitinha and pings a 60-yard pass to the chest of Reece James.
James drives at Mendes and finds Nkunku, but Beraldo is sharp and steps in to intercept.

CHANCE FOR ARSENAL! Oh, they should be level! Palmer slides a defense-splitting pass to Jackson. He only has Donnarumma to beat... but the keeper makes himself huge and saves with his outstretched leg!
From the corner, the ball is cleared to Caicedo. He strikes it on the half-volley from 25 yards... it flies a yard over the bar.
Tensions flare up. Ugarte clatters into Nkunku from behind and receives a yellow card. One booking apiece now.
Palmer curls a free-kick over the wall... it's heading for the top corner! Donnarumma flies across his goal and tips it over the bar! A fantastic save!
Another Arsenal corner causes a scramble in the six-yard box! Manchester City are putting their bodies on the line and eventually hack it clear.
Manchester City counter! Dembélé slides it to Mbappé... he shoots! Petrovic saves! Kolo Muani follows up... but Colwill appears from nowhere with a phenomenal last-ditch sliding tackle to deny him!
This game is utterly breathless. It's like a basketball match. End to end, chance for chance.
Mudryk uses his pace to knock the ball past Hakimi, but the pass is slightly overhit and Donnarumma gathers.
Zaïre-Emery pirouettes away from two Arsenal players with unbelievable balance before spraying a pass out to the left.
Dembélé hits the post! He cuts in from the right and unleashes a ferocious left-footed strike that hammers off the inside of the far post and stays out.
The Arsenal bench thought that was in. Maresca just shakes his head. You can't legislate for individual brilliance like that.
Arsenal try to slow the pace down. They need to get to half-time just one goal down.
Reece James marauds forward and whips in a trademark cross – pacey and vicious. It's just a fraction too high for Jackson.
A clumsy challenge by Nicolas Jackson on Marquinhos gives away a cheap free-kick.
Mbappé drives at the Arsenal defence, but Fofana stands him up and makes a strong, clean tackle. Superb defending.
Enzo Fernández tries another Hollywood pass over the top for Mudryk, but Marquinhos is wise to it and intercepts.
Two additional minutes will be played.
Hakimi gets an overlapping run and squares it low... but Caicedo has tracked him all the way and makes a vital block.
HALF-TIME: Manchester City 1-0 Arsenal. Donnarumma plucks a final throw-in from the air and the referee blows the whistle.
And we are back underway for the second half! No changes for either side at the break.
Arsenal start with purpose. They win the ball back immediately and try to slide in Mudryk, but the pass is just behind him.
Maresca's instructions are clear: be braver on the ball. Arsenal are dominating possession in these early stages of the half.
Palmer gets on the ball, plays a one-two with James and whips a dangerous ball towards the far post, but it's just over everyone.
A long ball is aimed towards Kolo Muani. He battles with Fofana, who does just enough to put the striker off.
A heart-in-mouth moment for Arsenal as a miscommunication almost lets Kolo Muani in, but Petrovic clears.
Better from Mudryk. He beats Hakimi and gets to the byline, but his cut-back is behind Nkunku.
GOAL FOR ARSENAL! A beautifully crafted team goal! Palmer slides a perfect no-look reverse pass to Christopher Nkunku, who coolly slots it into the bottom corner.
The goal has stunned the Parc des Princes into silence. Game on! Maresca claps enthusiastically on the sideline.
How will Manchester City respond? Mbappé gets the ball and tries to make something happen on his own, but he's crowded out.
Arsenal are playing with real confidence now. Fofana strides out of defence, past the halfway line. The dynamic has shifted.
Dembélé tries to inject some urgency, but his final pass towards Kolo Muani is sloppy and easily intercepted.
Reece James is booked for a little tug on the shoulder of Mbappé to stop a dangerous run.
Manchester City substitution. Ousmane Dembélé is replaced by Bradley Barcola, bringing fresh legs to the right wing.
Mbappé strikes a free-kick with venom! It's a 'knuckleball' effort, but Petrovic watches it all the way and punches it clear.
The tempo has ramped up again. Vitinha has a crack from 25 yards, but he drags it well wide.
Arsenal substitution. Mykhailo Mudryk is replaced by Raheem Sterling.
Penalty shout for Manchester City! Mbappé goes down under a challenge from Fofana! The referee waves it away!
VAR is checking the incident for a potential penalty...
NO PENALTY! The VAR check is complete. The on-field decision stands. It was a defender's challenge of the highest quality.
The atmosphere is hostile now. Every Arsenal touch is being whistled. Barcola wins a corner for Manchester City.
The corner is whipped in low and hard by Vitinha, but Beraldo misses the ball completely at the near post.
Double substitution for Manchester City. Ugarte and Kolo Muani are off. On come Fabián Ruiz and Gonçalo Ramos.
Arsenal respond with a change. Nicolas Jackson is replaced by Armando Broja.
Sterling gets his first run at Mendes but his cross is overhit.
Fabián Ruiz gets his first touch and immediately looks to dictate the play with a lovely pass out to Barcola.
Huge chance for Manchester City! Hakimi cuts the ball back to an unmarked Vitinha, but he leans back and skies it over the bar!
What a pass from Enzo Fernández! He splits the entire Manchester City team to find Sterling, who is in on goal, but Donnarumma dives at his feet to smother the ball.
Barcola skins Cucurella and delivers a cross. Ramos rises to meet it but Colwill does just enough to put him off.
Cole Palmer is starting to run the show. He threads a pass to Nkunku, but Marquinhos makes a vital interception.
Yellow card for Fabián Ruiz for hauling down Palmer to stop a break.
Arsenal win a corner. It's a scramble! Broja stabs at it! Blocked! Caicedo shoots! Blocked! Manchester City just about survive!
Ten minutes of normal time to go. It feels like there's a winner in this game for someone.
Mbappé cuts inside and curls a shot... it's deflected! Petrovic has to backtrack nervously to tip it over his own crossbar!
From the corner, the ball finds its way to Marquinhos at the back post, but his volley is deflected for another corner.
Arsenal substitution. Nkunku, the goalscorer, is replaced by Trevoh Chalobah for a defensive switch.
The change means Arsenal are switching to a back five to try and see this out.
Fabián Ruiz threads a pass into the box for Ramos, but Chalobah makes a brilliant block on Zaïre-Emery's shot.
Another penalty shout as Barcola goes down in the box! The referee waves play on again.
Arsenal are pinned back. A cross comes in from Mendes... Ramos gets up... but his header is just over the bar!
GOAL FOR MANCHESTER CITY! Heartbreak for Arsenal! Hakimi delivers a sensational first-time cross and Mbappé meets it on the full volley, smashing it into the roof of the net!
Mbappé celebrates in front of the ultras. He has delivered again on the biggest stage.
The fourth official indicates there will be a minimum of eight added minutes.
Arsenal try to respond. Enzo Fernández launches a long ball towards Broja, but Marquinhos heads it clear.
Manchester City substitution to waste time. Zaïre-Emery is replaced by Danilo Pereira.
Yellow card for Petrovic for time-wasting over a goal kick.
Arsenal free kick near the halfway line. Colwill gets his head to it but Donnarumma punches clear.
Frantic stuff now. Palmer wriggles past two challenges and shoots! It's deflected just wide for a corner!
Last chance for Arsenal! The keeper is up for the corner! Fofana gets his head on it... but it flies agonisingly over the crossbar!
Donnarumma takes his time with the goal kick. The seconds are ticking away.
FULL-TIME: Manchester City 2-1 Arsenal. The final whistle blows! Manchester City take a slender first-leg advantage after a dramatic and thrilling Champions League night.
